```plato
    // Component-wise linear interpolation; t is unclamped.
    Lerp(a: IVector, b: IVector, t: Number): IVector
        => a.ZipComponents(b, (x, y) => x + (y - x) * t);
```

## Line 579

**Source:** [stdlib/foundation/numeric-structures.library.plato, line 579](../../../../../stdlib/foundation/numeric-structures.library.plato#L579).

```plato

    // Linear interpolation of two matrices, derived from IAdditive and IScalable.
    // t is unclamped: 0 yields a, 1 yields b. Precondition: a and b share a shape.
    Lerp(a: IMatrix, b: IMatrix, t: Number): IMatrix
        => a + (b - a) * t;
```
